status_summary: S. 1371, the S-CAP Act of 2025 (Sen. Boozman, introduced 2025-04-09, referred to the Finance Committee), would raise the S corporation shareholder limit in IRC section 1361(b)(1)(A) from 100 to 250 for taxable years beginning after 2025; it does not mention crowdfunding or Regulation A shareholders, so it is a different approach to the same constraint. Its bill status record shows one cosponsor added on 2025-09-09 and no action after the referral. The section as published by Cornell's Legal Information Institute still sets the limit at 100 and lists no 2025 amendment.

timeline.event: S. 1371 was introduced to raise the S corporation shareholder limit from 100 to 250 and referred to the Senate Finance Committee.

title: Disregard crowdfunding and Regulation A holders in the S corporation shareholder limit
uncertainties: The S. 1371 BILLSTATUS record was read in this review on govinfo.gov (introduced and referred 2025-04-09, one cosponsor added 2025-09-09, no later action); the bill text was read by the researcher on govinfo.gov. Section 1361 text on the Legal Information Institute site may lag recent amendments, and no CRS or JCT summary of Public Law 119-21 was opened, so absence of a change in that law is not fully confirmed. One web search for a bill specific to crowdfunding or Regulation A shareholders returned only a 115th Congress bill (H.R. 531) and advocacy pages, so no 119th Congress bill of that kind was found; this is not proof none exists. congress.gov refuses fetches. Staging an introduced bill with a different approach as proposed parallel is a judgment call; not_started is defensible.
